description: This file defines classes and methods for managing document items within a Flutter app. It includes the DocItem data class and the DocsProvider class, which manages a list of document entries, including initialization with sample data, adding fake uploads, and removing documents.

classes.name: DocItem
classes.description: Represents a user document entry with fields such as id, title, creation date, thumbnail path, and summary.

classes.name: DocsProvider
classes.description: Manages a list of DocItem objects in memory, provides methods to initialize sample data, add fake uploads, and remove documents, and notifies listeners upon changes.

methods.name: initIfNeeded
methods.description: Seeds the data store with sample documents once, if not already initialized.

methods.name: addFakeUpload
methods.description: Creates and inserts a new fake uploaded document into the list, returning the created DocItem.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Removes a document by its id. Returns true if removal was successful.
